passage.ro: My name is Ana and I am eleven years old. I go to school in Brasov. My school is big and old. It has twenty classrooms and a small library. I get up at seven o'clock and I walk to school with my friend Maria. Our first lesson starts at eight. I like English and music, but I do not like maths. At twelve o'clock we have lunch in the canteen. After school I do my homework and play with my dog, Rex.

passage.ro: At the weekend my family goes to the park near our house. There is a big lake with ducks, and a playground for children. My dad usually runs round the lake, and my mum reads a book on a bench. My little brother plays on the swings and I ride my bike. Sometimes we take a picnic with sandwiches and apples. It is not far from our home, so we walk there. We stay in the park for three hours. When it rains, we stay at home and play board games.
